best_for: Hobby and small-business video makers on Windows, Mac or Linux who want a free editor with no watermark and are willing to learn its panel layout.

points.title: Free for any use
points.text: Shotcut is GPLv3 software, free for commercial work too. It needs no account or activation and sends no analytics.

points.title: Edit without importing
points.text: It reads files through FFmpeg and puts them on the timeline directly. It handles 4K and 8K, 10-bit video, HDR10 and HLG.

points.title: Filters, keyframes, tracking
points.text: There are many video and audio filters and transitions, keyframes for filter settings, and motion tracking. Audio gets scopes and automatic ducking.

points.title: Help for slower PCs
points.text: Preview scaling and proxy files cut preview lag. With hardware encoding on, the GPU can speed up exports.

points.title: Projects stay in Shotcut
points.text: Save writes an MLT XML project file; to get a video you must use Export.

points.title: 64-bit and recent systems only
points.text: Current builds need Windows 10 version 1809 or later, macOS 12 or later, or 64-bit Linux with glibc 2.35. Older systems must stay on old releases, such as 22.12.21 for Windows 7 and 8.

points.title: Builds and versions
points.text: Windows comes for x64 and Arm64, per user or for all users; the Mac build is universal. The Flathub Flatpak is verified. Windows keeps 52 versions; macOS and Linux list only the current release.
